authorization: User validated plan 0.4 and authorized V4-02A/V4-02B only; present results before product implementation.

product_decision.question_scope: S8 readiness and full technical journey acceptable waits
product_decision.user_quote: con ue haya una mejora de al menos el 20% es suficiente
product_decision.interpretation: At least 20% reduction of complete S8 technical journey against correctly used 3.4.3. Phase times remain visible; does not amend E1/E2/E3/E4 or human deferral.
product_decision.supersedes: Pending absolute product latency targets in plan 0.4 AC-39/AC-43; experimental cutoffs preserved.

baseline.valid_latency_baseline_status: One isolated public readiness sample on target 3.4.3 completed; full S8 reference remains future V4-06/V4-17A.

primary_time.aggregation: Median of two paired relative reductions, final AB and BA; report both values and absolute seconds.
additional_conditions: Both pairs must be valid and have positive reductions; a nonpositive pair is inconclusive for consistency, not silently discarded.
No introduced guarantee/functional defect; preserve all obligations, authority and fresh guards.
No valid candidate timeout, own error, or unfinished journey may pass.
Phase regression over 10% triggers the unchanged protocol investigation and disposition rule; no selecting only fast phases.
primary_time.zero_reference: If reference <=0 or unavailable, criterion remains not-measured; no invented percentage.

phase_time.L_readiness: Measured and reported, no absolute product maximum following user decision.
phase_time.L_transition: Measured by authorized semantic effect set, no absolute product maximum.
phase_time.L_delivery: Measured complete journey; primary relative requirement >=20%, no absolute product maximum.

experimental_limits.timeout_rule: Stop owned tree; preserve cost/partial data; failed or incomplete, never acceptance latency.

memory.metric: Windows Job Object peak committed bytes for owned CLI and its descendants; each semantic phase/run measured with same boundaries
memory.condition: Meet cap and relative ceiling per equivalent valid pair; missing metric stays pending.
memory.rationale: 512 MiB bounds this 338-element synthetic CLI case; 10% relative ceiling makes relevant growth explicit. Technical guard chosen before candidate, not a claim about current peak.

activity.brief_operation: If complete before 1s, final result suffices; no artificial wait.
activity.stdout_json: Preserve final valid JSON; use compatible opt-in separate channel; no percentage or ETA invented.

interrupt.scope: Cooperative CPU phases declared and tested; IO/native calls and material writes may defer to next safe point, explicitly reported.
interrupt.unmet_need_rule: If actual phase cannot meet contract, keep criterion pending; do not assert instant abort.
interrupt.recovery: Existing journal and current guards; preserve partial effects, evidence and later work; no duplicate effect.

activity_overhead.scope: Focal opt-in on/off validation, not another complete journey; all delivered activity bytes remain in total cost.

pending_external_conditions: Actual team consumer adoption/evidence to resolve its exact incident.
Future full S8 reference/candidate comparison and all product acceptance; not a prerequisite loop for this preparatory contract.
Actual remaining global capacity before future blocks; historical human/extra environment consumption unknown.
host_order: Codex first; Copilot final; no human effort experiment.

diagnostic_completion.invalid_reason: New unowned Python process detected during 3.4.2 target; no isolated latency inference.
